title: Offline and degraded behaviour: visible network state, retry affordances, no silent data loss
description: When the network is unavailable the application shows a non-blocking banner naming the condition, offers retry affordances on failed reads, and either queues writes for replay or clearly refuses them; a user-entered payload is never dropped silently. On reconnect the banner clears and queued work resumes or is surfaced for confirmation.
rationale: Silent data loss on a flaky connection is the least forgivable defect class. Queueing is preferred where the domain permits; visible refusal is the accepted fallback.
